integrity: Analytic proof supplied for the infinite-dimensional statement. Supplemental finite checks are not independent or exhaustive. No authorship, priority, or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characterizes bounded monomial-diagonal operators only; the off-diagonal full-U(d) matrix problem is not solved. General compact-Lie-group smooth vector methods are classical; unlocated equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: An angular graph criterion for full-unitary rotation continuity of diagonal Fock operators
